- [asterism-benchgen overview](asterism_benchgen/index.md): `asterism-benchgen` — the seeded corpus behind the grid/import benches.

## asterism-contract 0.0.0

- [asterism-contract overview](asterism_contract/index.md): # asterism-contract — Command / Query / Response DTOs
- [asterism-contract::command](asterism_contract/command.md): Command DTOs — inputs for state-changing operations.
- [asterism-contract::digest](asterism_contract/digest.md): The notation a digest is written in — the `sha256:` tag, and the
- [asterism-contract::dto](asterism_contract/dto.md): Response DTOs — outputs shared between the application services, the
- [asterism-contract::query](asterism_contract/query.md): Query DTOs — inputs for read-side operations.
- [asterism-contract::query_group](asterism_contract/query_group.md): Query Group `query_json` — the persisted rule of a query-backed Group.
- [asterism-contract::sidecar](asterism_contract/sidecar.md): The shape of an exported artefact's `<file>.meta.json` sidecar.
- [asterism-contract::sort](asterism_contract/sort.md): Sort specification DTO — the wire form of the grid's sort axis.
